title.narrative: TRUST ¿ TogetheR Unite efforts for regional StabiliTy

description.narrative:
IF border residents improve their peacebuilding skills, tolerance level, and understanding of conflicts, and participate in activities and dialogue with different ethnic groups on each side and across the border, THEN they will be more resilient to hateful rhetoric and radicalization leading to violent conflict and extremism BECAUSE closer ties with their own communities, mutual trust, friendships, social cohesion, and tolerance towards the other communities, together with improved conflict transformation skills will motivate and enable them to take an alternative pathway to violence.

At the level of activities, the action will (i) strengthen the operational and institutional capacity of three Kyrgyz, Tajik and Uzbek CSOs (Co-applicants) to mobilize and build capacities of local CSAs, and to enhance their networking skills on a local and regional level, and (ii) reducing conflict potential in selected locations through the wide range of community-led activities and developing cross-border dialogue.
